subject: Texture streaming and TXD pipeline (CTxdStore, CTexDictionary)
overview: GTA:SA streams textures via TXD (Texture Dictionary) archives. CTxdStore manages the global pool of loaded TXDs. Each model (DFF/IDE) references a parent TXD by name; at load time the streaming system requests that TXD from CTxdStore before the model can be made visible.

txd_file_format.description: A TXD is an RenderWare binary stream chunk (id 0x16 = rwID_TEXDICTIONARY). It contains a count of CTexture (platform-native texture) children, each a native texture platform chunk.

texture_format_header.u_addressing: uint8  — U wrap mode (clamp=1, wrap=2, mirror=3, border=4)
texture_format_header.name: char[32] — texture name (lookup key for RwTexDictionaryFindNamedTexture)
texture_format_header.mask_name: char[32] — alpha mask texture name (empty string = no mask)

CTxdStore_pool.note: Each slot holds an RwTexDictionary* and a reference count. Slots are claimed by name hash at load and freed when the ref count reaches zero.

TxdDef_fields.note: TxdDef is the streaming-slot entry. It stores the TXD name, parent TXD index (for parent-chain lookup), and the RwTexDictionary pointer.

parent_txd_chain.description: Each TXD can declare a parent TXD. Texture lookups walk the parent chain until a match is found or the root (no parent) is reached. Vehicle TXDs parent to 'vehicle.txd'; skin TXDs parent to 'player.txd'.

common_parents.vehicle.txd: parent of all vehicle-colour and decal TXDs
common_parents.player.txd: parent of CJ skin layer TXDs
common_parents.generic.txd: generic shared textures (shadow blob, weapon icons, etc.)

model_to_txd_binding.description: IDE (item definition) files contain a txd= field on each model line. CStreaming builds a model→TXD index from this at startup. When a model slot is loaded, CStreaming first ensures its TXD slot is loaded.

memory_budget.note: Texture memory is not explicitly budgeted; the streaming system evicts TXD slots by LRU when out of streaming budget. The budget is set by the platform in CStreaming::Init and is typically 48–96 MB on PC.
